name: ESMT Berlin (European School of Management and Technology)

program.length_note: 15 months, January start (intakes January 2027 and January 2028)

class_size.note: Class size not published; 'averaging 22 unique nationalities in each cohort'

tuition_total.note: Includes books, study materials, a Smart Certificate and study fees for trips/exchanges; excludes travel and accommodation. January 2028 intake: €51,000

mandatory_fees_total.note: No separate mandatory fee listed; health insurance is compulsory (see living budget)

monthly_sum_range_computed.note: Sum of the school's monthly items with a private room, computed by us, not published as a total

living_budget_total.note: School gives estimated average monthly living costs only; no programme total. Students over 30 cannot use student public health insurance

scholarship.note: Automatic awards: test score excellence €3,000; German language €500-€5,000 (combinable). Merit scholarships (one per student, self-funded only): regional up to €25,000 (Africa & Middle East), €10,000 (Latin America), €8,000 (Asia), €2,500 (North America); Panzer €20,000; BMW Group Change Maker Fellowship 2 x €45,000; others €5,000-€15,000. No average award published

employment.report_url_note: 2026 Employment Report is behind a download form; https://esmt.berlin/mba-programs/full-time-mba/employment-report returns 403 to curl and WebFetch. Figures below are from the career-impact page
employment.offers_note: Search extract of the (403) report page states for the Class of 2024: 80% of graduates seeking employment received job offers within six months; Class of 2023: 74% within three months. Not read on the page itself

base_salary.note: '€100K average total starting compensation', average of Classes 2023-2025: TOTAL compensation (not base), rounded by the school

employment.changed_country_note: 64% changed industry, role and location (triple change); 15% started their own business
employment.by_industry_note: Industry breakdown only in the gated report
employment.by_function_note: Past roles listed qualitatively: consultant, product/project manager, corporate leader, founder, senior marketing lead, analytics/innovation/growth specialist
employment.top_employers_note: 'Past top hiring companies include'; no hire counts

rankings_cited.note: School page: '#2 in Germany and #79 globally in the Financial Times MBA ranking 2026'

notes: Salary is a 3-class average of total compensation; not comparable with base-salary medians. Industry and function shares are in the gated 2026 report.
